construction: For exact m=N/2^k>=0 in lowest dyadic form, p=bit_length(N). If p<=53 use m. Else q=p-53, H=floor(N/2^q)*2^(q-k), L=(N mod 2^q)*2^-k. m=H+L exactly, H,L>=0. For actual p<=57, L has at most 4 significant bits.
projection_proof: Keep separate native constants: impose v=L with fixed bounds and S-v=H (S is physical net supply). Eliminating v gives S=H+L=m. Weighted annual sum 24*sum(m)=3*sum(original P). All source Q and physical demands unchanged.
warning: Ordinary two PyPSA Load entries sharing a Bus are insufficient: float64 groupby may collapse H+L back to rounded m. Future implementation must retain separate terms through CSC/native readback and acceptance/export mapping. This changes numerical representation and requires explicit approval; no production/model implementation in C01.
not_guaranteed: Numerical enforcement, presolve behavior, solver convergence or V4 PASS not demonstrated. No new supply/negative correction Load/slack is permitted.
